<div class="card-body">
'''The Shield Doors Must Be Closed''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">シールド・ドアを閉めなければ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">「エコー基地ドッキング・ベイ」と最も内側のマーカー位置の境界に配備する。“夜間状態”では、「エコー基地ドッキング・ベイ」と他の位置（エコー基地を除く）の間での移動はできなくなる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-The-Shield-Doors-Must-Be-Closed-PSA-149261355.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「姫、今夜はもはや手の打ちようがありません。もうシールド・ドアを閉めなければ」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' The Shield Doors Must Be Closed.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on the boundary between Echo Docking Bay and the innermost marker location. Under nighttime conditions, movement between Echo Docking Bay and other locations except Echo Base is not allowed.

'''Lore:'''
Princess, nothing more can be done tonight. The shield doors must close now.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed subtype is エフェクト.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[The Shield Doors Must Be Closed]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
